mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail with an overnight low of 62 degrees and no rain. The moon is a waning crescent, and if you look up at 9:05 PM, you can catch the ISS flying over from the southwest towards the east northeast.

In city news, the police department has arrested a Madison teacher on charges of sexual assault of a child, and the city has also shared updates on the Highway M construction and the new Tai Chi Animal Frolics art installation at Century School Park.

Today you can attend yoga at Insight Wellness, and tomorrow features a busy schedule including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, Paddy Mac's, The Mill, and The Bogey Factory, plus the downtown farmer's market.

In a report from the police department, an investigation launched on Sunday, August 30th, resulted in the arrest of a 34-year-old Madison resident last Friday on charges of sexual assault of a child by a school staff member.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
